say:1:1510296001:1.text: You seem to have some rather unfaithful followers, trying to eavesdrop on us like that.
say:1:1510296001:1.source_cn: 竟然想偷听我们的谈话，你的信徒们好像不够虔诚呢。
say:1:1510296001:1.male: You seem to have some rather unfaithful followers, trying to eavesdrop on us like that.
say:1:1510296001:1.female: You seem to have some rather unfaithful followers, trying to eavesdrop on us like that.

say:2:1510296002:1.text: However, no need to worry. I have a ward in place. Even if someone's eavesdropping, they'll only hear snippets of our conversations.
say:2:1510296002:1.source_cn: 别担心，我提前设下了防护魔法，就算有人偷听，也只能听见...
say:2:1510296002:1.male: However, no need to worry. I have a ward in place. Even if someone's eavesdropping, they'll only hear snippets of our conversations.
say:2:1510296002:1.female: However, no need to worry. I have a ward in place. Even if someone's eavesdropping, they'll only hear snippets of our conversations.

say:3:1510296003:1.text: I'm sure you'll come up with a suitable excuse. We'll leave at dawn. Until then, it's best you consider how to deal with your devoted flock.
say:3:1510296003:1.source_cn: 想个合适的借口对你来说一定不是难事，明天太阳升起后，我...
say:3:1510296003:1.male: I'm sure you'll come up with a suitable excuse. We'll leave at dawn. Until then, it's best you consider how to deal with your devoted flock.
say:3:1510296003:1.female: I'm sure you'll come up with a suitable excuse. We'll leave at dawn. Until then, it's best you consider how to deal with your devoted flock.
